categorical: Offline analysis establishes that the rejected serialized attribute kind 71 is LLVM 16 ZeroExt, not memory: the exact LLVM 16.0.0 Attribute::getNameFromAttrKind table maps 71 to the 7-byte string zeroext. The type-15 AIR bitcode is byte-identical (raw SHA-256 042303be...) to the converter's LLVM 16 llvm-as output, so the converter's re-serialization produced the rejected wire bytes while preserving the semantic attribute set. The host LLVM17 textual IR's memory(...) is a cross-version decode and is not used as the kind-71 name. No attribute was removed, no reader check was patched, and no device compiler/service/F11H run occurred. The exact zeroext parameter/return scope and the reader's LLVM version remain the next missing artifacts; a reader-matched llvm-as re-encoding is the supported semantics-preserving candidate, pending an isolated A/B.
